text:
mohit: Heads up — started a small recompute for last-week aggregates and noticed a 3x spike in p95 in us-west prod. Suspect the backfill is saturating the serving slice.
anna: ugh, saw the alerts. Is the backfill using the high-priority lane?
mohit: No, it landed on general worker pool. The replay job defaulted to throughput mode.
diego: We should gate it with gradual batching + token-rate shaping. Can we limit concurrent shards to 4 and add a slow-start ramp?
mohit: I pushed a quick change to scheduler: max_concurrency=4, ramp_seconds=180. Backfill-bot: "Starting job replay-2026-03-19 with concurrency 4 and ramp 180s" :robot_face:
sam: Can we also add a routing policy so live requests prefer dedicated instances? Right now routing is round-robin across the same hosts.
lucy: From product POV, we need guardrails so customer-facing latency doesn't slip during replays. A dashboard card that shows backfill throttle vs prod p95 would help.
diego: Agree. For now, can we mark a host-tag 'no-backfill' and route 30% traffic to that tag? Example:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  prefer_tag: no-backfill
  fallback: normal
  weight_prefer: 30
```
mohit: I can add the tag and a small routing rule. But we'd lose capacity for backfills — need to coordinate quotas.
anna: For quotas, I propose a soft quota for replay jobs per cluster: daily_tokens <= 10M and bursting capped at 1.2x for 10m windows. Violations should autoscale replay to lower concurrency.
sam: Implementation note: autoscaler currently can't read job-level tokens. We can approximate by measuring bytes_out or tokens_emitted from the replayer.
diego: Let's add a simple meter in replayer that emits metric replay.tokens and use an alert/quotas controller to scale down.
backfill-bot: "Metric replay.tokens emitted to metrics::replay.tokens (rate=4500 t/s)"
lucy: I'll add the dashboard card tied to that metric and a small UX blurb on Console: "Backfills respect cluster quotas and will ramp down to protect latency".
mohit: After the ramp change, p95 dropped back to baseline. Leaving the ramp on while we iterate on tagging/quota features.
anna: Action items: 1) mohit add tag + routing rule (ETA 1h). 2) diego add replay.tokens meter + controller PR (ETA EOD). 3) lucy dashboard + console copy (ETA tomorrow). 4) sam check autoscaler hooks (ETA EOD). I'll follow up in a thread.
diego: Also want to experiment with slot-based fair-share instead of token caps — cheaper for long tails. Filed a small RFC: https://intra.redwood/s/rfc/slot-fair-share (WIP)
mohit: thanks all, re-opening if we see any regressions.
infra-bot: "Deployment mohit/route-2026-03-19 completed on cluster us-west-2 (rollout=canary)"
